meta.description: Draft, audit, or revise Nature-style revision correspondence: point-by-point reviewer-separated responses, rebuttal letters, revision cover letters, LaTeX templates, red-marked manuscript excerpts. Enforces mutually blind reviewer isolation (no cross-reviewer info leakage), prevents reviewer-driven manuscript accretion (prefer replacement/compression/SI over appending), maps every claimed change to manuscript location. Eight task modes (draft/audit/revise/triage/cover-letter/package/latex/appeal), decision-type gate (major/minor/r&r/transfer).

scientific_integrity.detail: Does not invent experiments, citations, line numbers, figure panels. Marks AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED. Prevents manuscript accretion via main-text-discipline.md. Maps every claimed change to location.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for revision response. Decision-type gate prevents wrong strategy. Reviewer-missed-material treated as clarity signal (revise presentation, not 'already stated'). Appeal-like routed separately.

methodological_ground.detail: Mutually blind reviewer isolation sound. Major/Minor revision strategies distinct. Main-text discipline (replacement > compression > SI relocation > append). Package consistency audit (manuscript-letter agreement) rigorous.

code_usability.detail: Workflow clear. LaTeX templates provided. Package consistency script (check_package_consistency.py) for quoted text and page references. QA checklist. Comment taxonomy, action mapping, tone guidance.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive: eight task modes, decision-type gate, comment taxonomy, action mapping, standalone reviewer-separated responses, cover letter, red-marked manuscript, LaTeX templates, package consistency audit, QA checklist. Handles major/minor/r&r/transfer/appeal.

reliability.note: Excellent gates: decision-type gate mandatory, mutually blind reviewer isolation, does not invent content (AUTHOR_INPUT_NEEDED), package consistency audit (manuscript-letter agreement), main-text-discipline prevents accretion, QA checklist before finalization.

performance_context.note: Efficient on-demand loading: comment-taxonomy, action-mapping, difficult-cases, tone-stance, chinese-alignment, latex-templates, main-text-discipline, package-audit, qa-checklist loaded only when needed.

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow. Intake-and-routing.md for mode/readiness. Comment taxonomy for classification. Action mapping for tracker. Minor: no explicit token budget for very long review (10+ reviewers, 50+ comments).

human_usability.note: Strong bilingual support (中文核对 block). LaTeX templates for submission. Red-marked manuscript excerpts. Package readiness derived from item statuses. Bilingual triggers (修回信, 返修邮件, 逐点回复).

security.note: Excellent reviewer-privacy enforcement: mutually blind isolation, no cross-reviewer info in responses. Does not invent experiments/citations. Marks author input explicitly. Package consistency prevents misalignment between letter claims and manuscript.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular design: core stance/workflow stable, on-demand references (9 conditions), LaTeX templates, check_package_consistency.py script. Shared main-text-discipline from nature-shared. Clear extension points.

agent_specific.note: Strong workflow: decision-type gate, comment classification, action tracker, standalone responses per reviewer. Minor: no explicit parallel response drafting for multi-reviewer cases. Package consistency audit excellent but re-run requirement after every edit not automated.

key_strengths: Exceptional reviewer-privacy enforcement: mutually blind isolation, standalone responses per reviewer with no cross-reviewer information leakage
Strong main-text-discipline integration: prevents reviewer-driven manuscript accretion, prefers replacement > compression > SI relocation > append
Robust package consistency audit: check_package_consistency.py validates manuscript-letter agreement (quoted text, page references) after every edit
Sophisticated reviewer-missed-material handling: treats as clarity signal, revises presentation instead of defensive 'already stated' reply
Comprehensive task modes: draft, audit, revise, triage, cover-letter, revision-package, latex-template, appeal-like with decision-type gate

recommendations.title: Add LaTeX compilation validation before delivery
recommendations.problem: LaTeX templates (cover.tex, response.tex, manuscript_redline.tex) generated but no explicit compilation validation. Syntax errors or missing packages could cause compilation failure after delivery.
recommendations.root_cause: Template generation documented but compilation step not enforced.
recommendations.fix: Add to latex-template workflow: (1) generate .tex files, (2) run pdflatex (or lualatex) compilation, (3) check for errors in .log, (4) if compilation fails, identify error (missing package, syntax), suggest fix, (5) re-compile and verify PDF output. Include compilation as blocking gate before LaTeX package delivery.

recommendations.title: Automate package consistency audit re-run requirement
recommendations.problem: Package consistency audit (check_package_consistency.py) must re-run after every manuscript edit, but re-run requirement not automated. Agent must remember to re-run, easy to forget before final delivery.
recommendations.root_cause: Audit documented as multi-run requirement but not enforced in workflow state tracking.
recommendations.fix: Add state tracking: (1) mark manuscript_edited: true in state.json after any manuscript change, (2) block package delivery if manuscript_edited and last_audit_passed timestamps don't match, (3) auto-prompt re-run when attempting delivery with stale audit, (4) clear manuscript_edited flag after successful audit. Document in workflow step.

recommendations.title: Add parallel response drafting for multi-reviewer cases
recommendations.problem: Multi-reviewer major revision (R1 + R2 + R3) drafts responses sequentially. With mutually blind isolation, responses are independent and could be drafted in parallel by subagents to save time.
recommendations.root_cause: Workflow sequential by default. Parallel opportunity not exploited.
recommendations.fix: Add references/parallel-response-strategy.md: (1) identify independent reviewers (mutually blind), (2) dispatch one subagent per reviewer with shared comment taxonomy and action mapping, (3) each drafts standalone response, (4) merge responses into package, (5) run package consistency audit. Include token budget estimation (30k per reviewer baseline). Document when parallel worth overhead (3+ reviewers, 15+ comments).
